stories.title: Trump says U.S. won't attack Iran before midterms. And, ICE agent shoots man in NYC
stories.description: Trump announced that the U.S. will not attack Iran ahead of the midterms. And, a 28-year-old man is receiving treatment at the hospital after an ICE agent shot him in the neck.

stories.title: The long-deployed USS Lincoln returns home to San Diego Bay
stories.description: The USS Abraham Lincoln aircraft carrier has returned home after a record-setting uninterrupted time at sea supporting the Iran war. The extended deployment drew attention following reports of crew stress and supply shortages.

stories.title: Syrian general accused of atrocities is protected by U.S. and Lebanon, NPR and BBC find
stories.description: A former Syrian general wanted for crimes against humanity is living quietly in Lebanon, bankrolled and protected by American and Lebanese authorities, a BBC/NPR investigation has found.

stories.title: Three Saudi nationals killed in Houthi attacks on Riyadh airport
stories.description: The missile attacks come amid an escalation in fighting between the Iran-backed group and Saudi Arabia, which backs Yemen's government.

stories.title: Most UK diplomats to leave East Jerusalem consulate, Israel says, as Miliband says 'vital services' to remain
stories.description: Israel said in September it would act in response to UK sanctions on illegal Israeli settlements in the West Bank.

stories.title: US and Lebanon protecting wanted Syrian general, BBC finds
stories.description: Bassam al-Hassan is being sheltered in return for information - including about abducted US reporter Austin Tice.

stories.title: Three people killed in Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia airports, officials say
stories.description: The Houthis have claimed responsibility for the attacks, which mark an escalation in the conflict.

stories.title: White House defends Trump comment to let Iran 'take out' LA and San Diego
stories.description: Gavin Newsom called the remarks "deranged", but the White House said Trump was warning of the risk of a nuclear Iran.

stories.title: UK to make last-ditch effort to stop Israel closing East Jerusalem consulate
stories.description: Israel has threatened to close the consulate, which handles UK relations with Palestinians in the city, over British sanctions on Israeli settlements.

stories.title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels
stories.description: Experts say US military assistance, using shuttle tankers and pipelines bypassing the Strait of Hormuz mean exports have rebounded.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia reopens Riyadh airport after Houthi attack kills three
stories.description: Saudi Arabia has seen several attacks by the Houthis in recent days, with airports appearing to be the primary target.

stories.title: Is Trump signalling a return to war with Iran after the midterms?
stories.description: US media reports suggest he may be weighing strikes before the vote, but the president has ruled that out.

stories.title: Ex-OpenAI staff say they were fired for raising safety concerns

stories.title: India advises nationals in Saudi Arabia to remain vigilant amid escalating regional tensions
stories.description: The Indian Embassy in Riyadh has asked nationals to stay indoors as necessary, after attacks attributed to Houthi militants killed three people and disrupted flights between India and Saudi Arabia

stories.title: Air India, IndiGo cancel and divert Riyadh flights after missile threat
stories.description: Flights were disrupted after Iran-aligned Houthi rebels reportedly targeted Saudi Arabia, including a missile fired towards Riyadh International Airport.
